description: This Java source file defines a 'Playback' class that manages local media playback using Android's MediaPlayer API. It handles media control operations such as play, pause, seek, and stop, manages audio focus, resources, and responds to media events like completion, errors, and preparation. It interacts with a MusicProvider for media data and communicates playback state changes via a callback interface.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: Class responsible for local media playback management, including handling media session states, media resource management, audio focus, and responding to media events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates playback. Currently empty, placeholder for future implementation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback, releases resources, gives up audio focus, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current playback state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current playback state.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Indicates the playback connection status, always true in this implementation.

methods.name: isPlaying
methods.description: Checks if media is currently playing.

methods.name: getCurrentStreamPosition
methods.description: Returns the current playback position in milliseconds.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Handles playing a media item, including preparing media, requesting audio focus, and resource management.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses current playback, releases resources, and updates playback state.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Assigns a callback for playback events.

methods.name: tryToGetAudioFocus
methods.description: Requests audio focus from the system.

methods.name: giveUpAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases audio focus.

methods.name: configMediaPlayerState
methods.description: Configures media player according to current audio focus state and starts/stops playback accordingly.

methods.name: onAudioFocusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in audio focus, adjusting media player behavior accordingly.

methods.name: onSeekComplete
methods.description: Called when media seeking completes, updates current position and playback state.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Handles media playback completion event, signals to callback.

methods.name: onPrepared
methods.description: Handles media preparation completion, configures media player for playback.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles media playback errors, reports to callback.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates or resets the MediaPlayer instance and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: relaxResources
methods.description: Releases media and Wifi resources; optionally releases MediaPlayer.

methods.name: registerAudioNoisyReceiver
methods.description: Registers receiver to handle noisy audio intents when headphones disconnect.

methods.name: unregisterAudioNoisyReceiver
methods.description: Unregisters the noisy audio receiver.
